review_candidates.description: Content Producer – Marketing Company Description Monerti is a licensed property management company committed to reshaping how real estate is managed and experienced. Operating under RERA License Number B202408/1300, the organization focuses on delivering transparent, compliant, and customer-centric property services. Team members at Monerti collaborate closely to improve operational efficiency and service quality across diverse property portfolios. The company values professionalism, integrity, and innovation, creating an environment where individuals can contribute to the evolution of modern property management. Role Description Monerti is looking for a creative, fast-moving **Content Producer** to join our marketing team on a full-time, on-site basis in Bahrain. This is a hands-on role for someone who can create and publish high-quality content every day. You will be responsible for turning Monerti’s services, properties, team activity, customer value, and market insights into engaging content for social media and digital channels. The ideal candidate is comfortable taking ownership of the full content process, from idea generation and planning to filming, editing, writing captions, scheduling, and reviewing performance. You should understand how to create platform-native content that builds brand awareness, trust, engagement, and leads. Key Responsibilities Create daily social-media content for Monerti across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, and other relevant channels. Produce short-form videos, including Reels, Stories, TikToks, property walkthroughs, team videos, educational content, customer-focused content, and behind-the-scenes content. Plan content ideas and maintain a structured daily, weekly, and monthly content calendar. Film content on-site at properties, offices, meetings, events, and other relevant locations when required. Edit videos, images, graphics, and social-media assets using tools such as CapCut, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar platforms. Write engaging captions, hooks, scripts, headlines, calls to action, and basic marketing copy aligned with Monerti’s brand voice. Turn property-management topics, rental insights, real-estate updates, and customer questions into simple, useful, and engaging content. Monitor social-media trends, formats, audio, and audience behavior, then adapt relevant trends to Monerti’s brand in a professional manner. Coordinate with management, operations, and marketing teams to collect information, content opportunities, and campaign updates. Schedule and publish approved content consistently across relevant social-media platforms. Maintain an organized library of footage, photos, templates, creative assets, and published content. Track key content-performance metrics such as reach, views, watch time, engagement, saves, shares, follower growth, and inquiries. Recommend improvements based on performance data and test new content formats regularly. Ensure all content is accurate, professional, compliant, and consistent with Monerti’s brand standards. Qualifications Demonstrated experience as a Content Producer, Content Creator, Social Media Executive, Digital Marketing Executive, or in a similar role. Proven ability to produce high-quality daily content, particularly short-form video for social platforms. Strong video filming and editing skills using mobile and/or professional camera equipment. Strong working knowledge of Instagram Reels, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, and other relevant content platforms. Ability to write clear, engaging captions, scripts, and marketing copy in English. Arabic is a strong advantage. Experience using CapCut, Canva, Adobe Premiere Pro, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Lightroom, or similar tools. Strong understanding of social-media trends, content hooks, storytelling, and audience engagement. Ability to work quickly, manage multiple projects, and deliver content within short deadlines. Strong attention to detail, visual quality, brand consistency, and accuracy. Experience in real estate, property management, hospitality, lifestyle, fintech, or a service-based business is beneficial. A portfolio demonstrating previous video, social-media, design, or content-production work is required. Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Media, Communications, Design, or a related field is beneficial, but not essential where relevant experience and portfolio are strong. Immediate joiners preferred.

Кожного року ми демонструємо кратне зростання як у чисельності команди, так і в кількості користувачів у всьому світі. Ajax Systems має виробництво повного циклу: від генерації ідей та створення прототипів до масового виробництва та продажу по всьому світу. Кожен департамент закриває певну операційну потребу бізнесу в повній мірі. Фахівці компанії залучені на всіх етапах: від виробничої лінії в Україні до логістичного центру в Польщі, звідки продукцію відправляють дистрибʼюторам по всьому світу. Ми шукаємо Chief Physical Infrastructure Officer який приєднається до нашої команди та допоможе забезпечувати високі результати й ефективність у швидкозростаючій динамічній організації. У цій ролі ви відповідатимете за стратегію, розвиток і операційне управління фізичною інфраструктурою Ajax Systems — офісами, виробничими майданчиками, складами та іншими об’єктами. У фокусі ролі — запуск нових локацій з нуля, забезпечення безперебійної роботи інфраструктури, управління бюджетами, підрядниками та сервісними партнерами, а також побудова масштабованих процесів і високого рівня внутрішнього сервісу для співробітників. Launch new facilities (offices, manufacturing & warehouses) from scratch (from planning and construction to opening and operations. Ensure all locations are clean, protected, comfortable, and fully operational. Keep infrastructure fully operational: energy, IT systems, security. Manage major budgets, vendors, contractors, and partners. Develop scalable standards, processes, and service levels across all locations. Continuously improve efficiency, reliability, and employee experience. Delivering an Internal service: employees should feel as guests in the hotels, etc. Requirements Proven experience leading large and complex real estate / facilities portfolios.
